🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Indecent Behavior and Friends Don't Lie co-headline German tour

Indecent Behavior and Friends Don't Lie share the bill on the Good Times, Bad Decisions Tour. MoreCore counts 14 club dates in Germany and Austria between November 2026 and late February 2027, including Stuttgart, Leipzig, Munich and Vienna.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Social Distortion named as Ruhrpott Rodeo 2027 headliner

Ruhrpott Rodeo has announced Social Distortion as a headliner for its 2027 edition. Lambrini Girls are also on the bill of the punk festival, which takes place in Hünxe, Germany, from 2 to 4 July 2027.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Slam Dunk 2027 lineup grows with Billy Talent and Cobra Starship

Slam Dunk Festival 2027 plays Leeds on 29 May and Hatfield on 30 May. Bowling For Soup, Simple Plan and Killswitch Engage top the bill, and a second wave added Billy Talent, Cobra Starship and Joyce Manor. Camping is offered at both sites for the first time.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Hot Mulligan join Rock am Ring and Rock im Park 2027

Hot Mulligan have been added to the 2027 lineup of Rock am Ring and Rock im Park. Hot Milk also joined the festival pair, which runs from 4 to 6 June 2027 at the Nürburgring and in Nuremberg, Germany.
